english.note: Use 嘥 as the all-purpose colloquial verb for needlessly squandering money, time, or resources.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for wasting money, time, opportunities, or other resources.

examples.english: I waste money buying useless things.
examples.traditional: 我成日嘥錢買啲冇用嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 saai1 cin2 maai5 di1 mou5 jung6 ge3 je5

examples.english: We can't squander any more time on these pointless arguments.
examples.traditional: 我哋唔可以再嘥時間喺呢啲無謂爭拗上。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 saai1 si4 gaan3 hai2 ni1 di1 mou4 wai6 zang1 aau3 soeng6
